item.text: I’m refactoring the wiring layer now. The goal is to move graph loading, algorithm execution, and output formatting into a small application object so the entrypoint stops assembling the whole use case itself.

The wiring split is in place. I’m compiling and running it against the clean build output now, then I’ll do one pass over the new entrypoint and application types to make sure the boundaries are actually cleaner.

Continued the refactor by extracting the orchestration layer out of the entrypoint.

[MST.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MST.java:5) now just boots an [MstApplication.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MstApplication.java:1), which coordinates three explicit dependencies: a [GraphSource.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/GraphSource.java:1), a [MinimumSpanningTreeAlgorithm.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MinimumSpanningTreeAlgorithm.java:1), and an [MstResultFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MstResultFormatter.java:1). The previous static utility roles were replaced with concrete implementations: [SampleGraphSource.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/SampleGraphSource.java:1) and [TabularMstFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/TabularMstFormatter.java:1).

That makes the top-level flow easier to swap or test without changing `main`, and removes another pair of catch-all static helper classes.
